text:
Elliot (People Ops): Quick heads-up: two small policy items going live today: 1) a 'quiet period' guidance for major launch weeks (advisory only) to encourage minimal PTO approvals for launch-critical roles; 2) tightened vendor conduct registration for offsites. Full details + FAQ: https://intranet.redwood/people/launch-quiet-period-2026. Please skim if you run or attend events. :information_source:

Rina (People Ops): Clarifying the quiet period: it's an advisory for people listed as 'launch-critical' on the roster. Managers can still approve emergency or pre-approved PTO. If you had PTO approved before today, it's grandfathered.

Marcus (Finance): Operational note on vendor expenses: any vendor-paid travel or swag must be declared on the Vendor Registration form at least 5 business days before the event. Unregistered items may delay reimbursements.

Priya (Legal): Reminder: vendor reps at company events must agree to the updated Code of Conduct. We added a short registration attestation (no legalese). Link in the doc.

Sam (Eng): I9m on the launch roster and have a doctor's appt during the week. Is medical still fine?

Elliot (People Ops): Yes. Medical appointments and emergencies are exceptions. Quiet period is to avoid discretionary PTO during intense ship windows, not to block needed care. DM me if you want us to flag your approval as exception.

PolicyBot: Vendor registration updated: new attestation field "No prohibited gifts" added. Commands: `/policy status` `/policy help`. See https://intranet.redwood/vendor-policy for details.

Rina (People Ops): We're hosting a 20-min drop-in tomorrow 4pm PT to answer questions and take exception requests. Will pin the FAQ after the session. :pushpin:

Marcus (Finance): Also noting that receipts for vendor spend must be submitted within 30 days. If vendor covered airfare and you need reimbursement, include the vendor confirmation and expense ticket.

Priya (Legal): For any cross-border vendor activations, coordinate with Legal early. Some countries require additional disclosures.

Sam (Eng): Thanks, will DM my appt info.

Elliot (People Ops): Thanks all. Bringing this to people-ops pinned updates after office hours. Appreciate teams being flexible around the launch weeks.
